interpretation.measured: A single 29-entry map was observed under operatorCache. Every traversal exhausted the 32768-entry allowance and stopped 872 objects at depth 8. These partial counters do not identify which individual cached values contribute the payload.
interpretation.definitions: String lengths include observed references and can share storage; array/map sizes are logical sizes and can exceed traversed entries. View extents can overlap. No logical counter is retained heap/native bytes.
interpretation.existingMechanism: Cache.getOrSet already calls bounded hard-expiry pruning with 64 checks per read. Reuse that implementation; do not duplicate it or interpret the capacity comment as measured memory.
